b1-01-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Back Then at Home
b1-01-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg what life was like at home in South Africa when she was a child. You (Meg) say that back then your family lived there and that the mood at home was always good.
b1-01-01.prompt: Tell Petra where you lived back then and that the mood at home was always good.
cues: Say which time you mean
Say where your family lived
Say what the mood at home was like
b1-01-01.target: Akkoriban Dél-Afrikában laktunk. Mindig jó volt a hangulat otthon.
b1-01-01.english: Back then we lived in South Africa. The mood at home was always good.
b1-01-01.canDo: I can open a story by naming when and where it happened.

b1-01-02.title: Communicative Challenge: After the Letter
b1-01-02.scenario: Petra asks Meg what she did this morning after she arrived at the office. You (Meg) read the letter that was on your desk, and Petra was making coffee at the same time.
b1-01-02.prompt: Tell Petra that after you arrived at the office you read the letter, and say what she was doing at the same time.
cues: Say what you did after you arrived at the office
Say what Petra was doing at the same time
b1-01-02.target: Miután megérkeztem az irodába, elolvastam a levelet. Eközben Petra kávét főzött.
b1-01-02.english: After I arrived at the office, I read the letter. Meanwhile Petra was making coffee.
b1-01-02.canDo: I can say that one event happened after another using miután + past tense.

b1-01-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Before the Trip
b1-01-03.scenario: Petra asks Meg and Károly what they did before they set off on their trip. You (Meg) checked the tickets and closed the window.
b1-01-03.prompt: Tell Petra that before you and Károly set off, you checked the tickets and closed the window.
cues: Say what you did before you set off
Add a second thing you did
b1-01-03.target: Mielőtt elindultunk, ellenőriztük a jegyeket, és becsuktuk az ablakot.
b1-01-03.english: Before we set off, we checked the tickets and closed the window.
b1-01-03.canDo: I can say that one event happened before another using mielőtt + past tense.

b1-01-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Late at Petra's
b1-01-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg how the evening at Petra's went. You (Meg) searched for her house for a long time, arrived in the end, and the result was that you were two hours late.
b1-01-04.prompt: Tell Károly that you searched for Petra's house for a long time, that you arrived in the end, and that you ended up two hours late.
cues: Say how long you searched, and for what
Say how it ended
Say what the result was
b1-01-04.target: Sokáig kerestük Petra házát, végül megérkeztünk. Az eredmény az volt, hogy két órát késtünk.
b1-01-04.english: We looked for Petra's house for a long time, in the end we arrived. The result was that we were two hours late.
b1-01-04.canDo: I can close a story using végül and az eredmény az volt, hogy.

b1-01-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Day of the Storm
b1-01-05.scenario: Anna asks Meg to tell the story of a trip in one go. Back then you lived in a small village; after you arrived you went for a walk; before you went home a storm came; in the end everyone was satisfied.
b1-01-05.prompt: Tell Anna the whole story: set the scene, say what you did after you arrived, say what happened before you went home, and say how it ended.
cues: Set the scene
Say what you did after you arrived
Say what happened before you went home
Say how it ended
b1-01-05.target: Akkoriban egy kis faluban laktunk, és miután megérkeztünk, elmentünk sétálni. Mielőtt hazamentünk, jött egy vihar, de végül mindenki elégedett volt.
b1-01-05.english: Back then we lived in a small village, and after we arrived we went for a walk. Before we went home a storm came, but in the end everyone was satisfied.
b1-01-05.canDo: I can put opening, sequencing, turning point and closing language together in one story.

b1-01-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Busy Day at Work
b1-01-consolidation.scenario: Anna asks Meg to tell the story of a busy day at work: back then you worked a lot on the project; after the letter arrived you went to Petra; before you went home you phoned Károly; in the end everyone was satisfied.
b1-01-consolidation.prompt: Tell Anna the story of the busy day: how it started, what you did after the letter arrived, what you did before going home, and how it ended.
cues: Set the scene
Say what you did after the letter arrived
Say what you did before you went home
Say how it ended
b1-01-consolidation.target: Akkoriban sokat dolgoztam a projekten. Miután megérkezett a levél, elmentem Petrához, és mielőtt hazamentem, felhívtam Károlyt. Az eredmény az volt, hogy mindenki elégedett volt.
b1-01-consolidation.english: Back then I worked a lot on the project. After the letter arrived, I went to Petra, and before I went home I phoned Károly. The result was that everyone was satisfied.
b1-01-consolidation.canDo: I can open a story, sequence its events, mark its turning point and close it.

b1-orszagma-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Hungary Lies
b1-orszagma-01.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you where Hungary is.
b1-orszagma-01.prompt: Tell the official where Hungary lies and say that it has no direct coastline.
cues: Say where Hungary lies
Say it has no direct coastline
b1-orszagma-01.target: Magyarország Közép-Európában, a Kárpát-medencében fekszik. Szárazföldi ország, nincs közvetlen tengerpartja.
b1-orszagma-01.english: Hungary lies in Central Europe, in the Carpathian Basin. It is a landlocked country and has no direct coastline.
b1-orszagma-01.canDo: I can explain where Hungary is located, using Közép-Európában and a Kárpát-medencében.

b1-orszagma-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Counties and the Capital
b1-orszagma-02.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you about Hungary's counties and its capital.
b1-orszagma-02.prompt: Tell the official how many counties Hungary has and say where the capital lies.
cues: Say how many counties there are
Name the capital and say where it lies
b1-orszagma-02.target: Magyarországon tizenkilenc vármegye van. Budapest a főváros, a Duna mentén fekszik.
b1-orszagma-02.english: There are nineteen counties in Hungary. Budapest is the capital, and it lies along the Danube.
b1-orszagma-02.canDo: I can say that Hungary has 19 counties (vármegyék) and that Budapest is the capital.

b1-orszagma-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Colours of the Flag
b1-orszagma-03.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you about the national flag.
b1-orszagma-03.prompt: Tell the official how many stripes the flag has and what the three colours stand for.
cues: Say how many stripes the flag has
Say what each colour stands for
b1-orszagma-03.target: A lobogó három vízszintes sávból áll. A hagyomány szerint a piros az erőt, a fehér a hűséget, a zöld a reményt jelképezi.
b1-orszagma-03.english: The flag consists of three horizontal stripes. According to tradition, red stands for strength, white for loyalty and green for hope.
b1-orszagma-03.canDo: I can describe the Hungarian flag's colours (piros, fehér, zöld) and their traditional symbolic meanings.

b1-orszagma-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungary's Neighbours
b1-orszagma-04.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you about the countries around Hungary.
b1-orszagma-04.prompt: Tell the official how many neighbours Hungary has and name two of them with the direction they lie in.
cues: Say how many countries Hungary borders
Name two of them and where they lie
b1-orszagma-04.target: Magyarország hét országgal határos. Északon Szlovákiával, keleten Romániával határos.
b1-orszagma-04.english: Hungary borders seven countries. In the north it borders Slovakia, in the east Romania.
b1-orszagma-04.canDo: I can name Hungary's seven neighbouring countries and say where some of them lie using compass directions.

b1-orszagma-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Short Summary
b1-orszagma-05.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official greets you and asks for a short summary of Hungary's geography.
b1-orszagma-05.prompt: Greet the official, then say where Hungary lies and name its two big rivers.
cues: Greet the official
Say where Hungary lies
Name the two big rivers
b1-orszagma-05.target: Jó napot kívánok! Ha a földrajzi fekvést tekintjük, Magyarország a Kárpát-medencében fekszik. Két nagy folyója a Duna és a Tisza.
b1-orszagma-05.english: Good day! If we consider the geographic location, Hungary lies in the Carpathian Basin. Its two big rivers are the Danube and the Tisza.
b1-orszagma-05.canDo: I can summarize Hungary's location, regions and rivers in a few connected sentences.

b1-orszagma-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Two More Questions
b1-orszagma-consolidation.scenario: At the end of your naturalization interview, the official asks two more questions about the map of Hungary.
b1-orszagma-consolidation.prompt: Say which region Pécs and Debrecen are in, then say where the Tisza flows into.
cues: Say where Pécs is
Say where Debrecen is
Say where the Tisza flows into
b1-orszagma-consolidation.target: Pécs a Dunántúlon van, Debrecen pedig az Alföldön. A Tisza a Dunába torkollik.
b1-orszagma-consolidation.english: Pécs is in Transdanubia, and Debrecen is on the Great Plain. The Tisza flows into the Danube.
b1-orszagma-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about Hungary's location, counties, rivers and cities.
